name: Bossa flute melody
desc: Gentle bossa nova melody on the wt_flute wavetable in Ab major: Jobim-shaped phrases that lean on the 9th and 13th, syncopated pickups anticipating the bar, lots of air between phrases; peak adds a discreet lower-third harmony voice.

root.doc: semitone offset from Ab major home

code.full: note("<[~ [~ bb4] c5@2] [[bb4 ab4] g4 ~ [~ eb4]] [f4@2 [g4 ab4] bb4] [[c5 bb4] g4@2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").attack(.03).decay(.35).sustain(.45).release(.25).shape(.25).lpf(sine.range(3600,5000).slow(24)).clip(.92).gain(${gain}).pan(sine.range(.43,.57).slow(20)).room(.45).delay(${breath}).delaytime(.5).delayfeedback(.28).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[~ [~ bb4] c5 [eb5 c5]] [[bb4 ab4] g4 [~ ab4] [bb4 eb4]] [f4 [g4 ab4] bb4 [c5 db5]] [[c5 bb4] g4 [f4 eb4] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.4).release(.2).shape(.3).lpf(sine.range(4000,5400).slow(12)).clip(.9).gain(${gain}), note("<[~ ~ ab4 ~] [~ eb4 ~ ~] [~ ~ g4 ~] [ab4 ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_flute").attack(.04).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.2).lpf(3800).gain(${gain}*.5).pan(.6)).room(.42).delay(${breath}*.8).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.25).orbit(5).play()
